statements.status_notes: The Go vulnerability database withdrew GO-2026-6168 with the reason "Report mistakenly added without having CVE / GHSA associated". The withdrawal does not state that the reported SCRAM iteration-count behavior was disproven, and the reviewed record identifies github.com/lib/pq@v1.12.3 as vulnerable. CloudNativePG 1.27.x uses v1.12.3 to match upstream CloudNativePG 1.28 and later, but that version is not claimed as a fix. Impact and exploitability remain under investigation.
